title: FUMI Prickly Pear Nicotine Pouches - 8mg per Pouch
description: FUMi Prickly Pear Strong Nicotine Pouches offer a smooth, gently sweet flavour inspired by cactus fruit. With hints of Pear, Watermelon and a mild tropical backdrop, this pouch delivers a subtly distinctive taste without overpowering your senses. Each slim, all-white pouch is designed to sit discreetly under the lip and releases 8mg of nicotine steadily for up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, they offer a clean and convenient experience that fits any routine. Each can contains 20 soft, plant-fibre pouches, crafted in Sweden by Helix AB to high production standards. Nicotine Range: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
